core.title: Designer ADA Storeroom Function Access Door Lever, Weslock 0642A

text.description_html:
Weslock 0642A, ADA Storeroom Function Access Door Leverset

This designer ADA compliant Access Lever is available in Satin Chrome finish. Concealed mounting screws give this Weslock made lever a clean finished look. It fits standard pre-drilled doors. The Designer ADA Access Door Lever is adjustable to fit door thicknesses from 1-3/8 inches to 1-3/4 inches. The backset is also adjustable for either 2-3/8 inches or 2-3/4 inches with a removable faceplate. The ANSI grade storeroom function is panic-proof, meaning that turing the interior lever always opens the door for immediate egress in case of an emergency situation.

The Access Lever is from the Weslock Traditionale Collection which features solid brass construction backed by lifetime mechanical and finish warranties.

Features of the Designer ADA Access Door Lever:

  • Storeroom function meets ANSI A 156.2 Grade 2 cylindrical lock standards.
  • Rose and lever material: Solid Brass
  • Adjustable latches include removable faceplates.
  • 5-pin lock cylinder for entry function.
  • Removable door lever prevents scratching during installation.
  • Storeroom function - key required for entry, one turn of interior lever unlocks and opens door for egress.
  • Limited Lifetime Mechanical Warranty
  • Limited Lifetime Year Finish Warranty
  • Fully ADA Compliant

Specifications of the Weslock Designer ADA Access Door Lever:

  • Finish: Satin Chrome
  • Lever Length: 4-3/4"
  • Lever Projection: 2-1/4"
  • Rose: Round
  • Rose Diameter: 2-1/2"
  • Door Thickness: adjustable from 1-3/8" to 1-3/4"
  • Backset: adjustable for either 2-3/8" or 2-3/4" with removable faceplate
  • Fits doors prepared with 2-1/8" cross hole and 1" edge hole

Sold Individually
